existing_identificationCriteria:
A Special Needs Assessment Panel receives, examines and assesses each child referred
Panel is drawn from education, social services and the Gibraltar Health Authority
Panel need not act unless satisfied the parents have been consulted
Threshold: significantly greater difficulty in learning than most children of the age
Not a learning difficulty solely because the teaching language differs from home
existing_referralPathway:
A Department officer may serve written notice requiring a child be examined
A parent may ask the Director to have the child medically examined
Parental consent is not needed for a child to be referred to the panel
Parent must be given notice of the examination and may attend it
existing_legalEntitlement:
Education and Training Act obliges the Minister to make SEND education provision
Director, on the panel's recommendation, must ascertain which children require SEND
Department of Education must keep its SEND arrangements under review
Parent may appeal a section 47(1) decision to the SEND Review Panel
existing_funding:
Education provided in Government schools is free for children of compulsory school age
For a placement outside Gibraltar the Department may pay fees in part or in full
existing_workforce:
Paediatric service at the Primary Care Centre is staffed by four therapists
The adult service at St Bernard's Hospital is staffed by one therapist
Therapy is delivered at the Centre, in schools, nurseries and in some cases at home
Two paediatric vacancies arose in the twelve months to April 2023, one on retirement
Government said Brexit made recruiting qualified UK specialists harder (2023 release)

docLinks.label: Isle of Man Government, Children's Speech and Language Therapy Service
Isle of Man Education Act 2001 (AT 33 of 2001), Department of Education, Sport and Culture
The Education (Special Educational Needs) Regulations 2004, Statutory Document No. 433/04

existing_identificationCriteria:
A list of support needs, not a diagnosis: understanding language and talking
On referral the service gives assessment, review and advice or an intervention programme
existing_referralPathway:
Referrals taken from parents or carers, GP, health visitor, school nurse, teachers
The team is based at the Community Health Centre in Douglas
Children are referred on for off-island assessment at specialist clinics
existing_legalEntitlement:
Education Act 2001 with the Special Educational Needs Regulations 2004 approved by Tynwald
The Department must arrange the provision its report specifies for the child
Where provision is at another school the Department pays the whole of the fees
A parent may appeal to a committee of two or more people the Department appoints

Government of Jersey, Special educational needs: what support is available
Government of Jersey, Assessing educational needs
Government of Jersey, Special Educational Needs (SEN) Code of Practice (under review, Feb 2024)

existing_terminology:
SLCN, speech language and communication needs, is the Code of Practice category
Developmental language disorder (DLD) is named on the SALT service page
Health service brands itself Children's Speech and Language Therapy, shortened to SALT
Code of Practice marked under review, February 2024, by the department
existing_identificationCriteria:
A Record of Need follows an exceptional action assessment that indicates one is needed
SEN means a learning difficulty calling for special educational provision to be made
Learning difficulty is significantly greater difficulty learning than most children that age
Home language difference alone is not a learning difficulty under the 1999 Law
existing_multilingualProvision:
Difficulties related solely to limitations in English as an additional language are not SEN
Schools must establish whether lack of progress is command of English or SEN
Annual review timing must account for a family whose first language is not English
existing_referralPathway:
Anyone can refer a child to the children's SALT service
In school, a continuing concern goes from the class teacher to the school's SENCo
Health staff suspecting SEN below school age must notify the Pre-School Forum
Parental consent is required before a SALT referral is accepted
existing_serviceModel:
SALT works in its own clinic, nurseries, schools, the hospital, the home and community clinics
Team is based at the Child Development and Therapy Centre, Enid Quenault centre
SEN Code of Practice defines speech and language therapy as a health care profession
Service also trains families, education staff and other professionals in communication
existing_legalEntitlement:
The 1999 Law carries a general presumption in law of mainstream education
Minister must ensure every child with SEN has the special educational provision required
Minister must ensure every child with SEN is identified and their provision assessed
Parents have a right to request an assessment of whether their child has SEN
existing_funding:
SEN resources are set by a funding formula reviewed at least annually
A Record of Need brings extra funding where cost exceeds ordinarily available support
Early years states providers get additional banded funding for children with SEN
Delegated SEN funding is expected to be used exclusively to address SEN needs
